name: council
description: Run Codex council reviews with native reviewers and strict inline boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Run strictly bounded Codex reviewer-agent councils
interface.longDescription: Use when user asks $council/review/debate. First check: if all/broad or >6 reviewers lacks same-prompt approval, output exactly: Council not run: broad council approval not granted. Stop immediately; no preface or tools. Otherwise read SKILL, spawn native reviewers, and never answer solo.
defaultPrompt: Use $council to review this code or plan with best-fit reviewers; inline text is the full target.
Use $council all for a broad engineering and UX review after explicit approval.
Use $council debate to compare hard tradeoffs.
